listing.name: Demolition Man (3DO) — pc-demolitionman (vs-sr-dev)
listing.summary: Experimental project. a 28-minute attract-mode run covering all level types and the first lightgun level/HUD; completion of the full campaign has not been confirmed. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: 3DO DemolitionMan own originaldisc/Portfolio21.10 files. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Own-disc extraction/ARMstatic generation then CMake pfboot --window, declared mouse/Gamegun timing. These are manual setup instructions. Portcove does not manage this download or confirm setup or gameplay.
